meta.name: drive-motivation
meta.description: Design motivation systems using Autonomy, Mastery, and Purpose (AMP) for products and teams. Use when the user mentions "intrinsic motivation", "gamification isnt working", "rewards arent working", "autonomy", "mastery", "purpose-driven", "my team is disengaged", or "how do I motivate people". Also trigger when designing onboarding progression, fixing broken gamification, or building team structures that sustain high performance. Covers why carrot-and-stick fails and how to build progress systems. For habit-forming product loops, see hooked-ux. For retention behavior design, see improve-retention.

copy.tagline: 用自主、胜任、归属三要素设计激励系统
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果团队或产品需要提升内在动力而非依赖外部奖励。
copy.tagline_en: Design motivation systems using autonomy, mastery, and purpose.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to boost intrinsic motivation in teams or products.

howto.what: Claude 会基于自主性、掌控感和目标感（AMP）框架，帮你设计产品、团队或组织的内在动机系统。它会诊断现有激励方案，指出问题并给出改进建议。
howto.when: 当你提到“内在动机”、“自主性”、“掌控感”、“目标驱动”、“团队缺乏动力”等关键词，或讨论入职引导、游戏化修复、团队建设时触发。

say.text: 我的团队缺乏动力，怎么用AMP框架改进？
say.note: Claude会诊断团队动机系统并给出建议。

say.text: 这个游戏化方案为什么效果不好？
say.note: Claude会分析是否过度依赖外部奖励。

say.text: 如何设计产品的新手引导，让用户更有自主性？
say.note: Claude会提供自主性增强的具体设计模式。

howto.what_en: Claude uses the Autonomy, Mastery, and Purpose (AMP) framework to help you design intrinsic motivation systems for products, teams, or organizations. It diagnoses existing incentive schemes, identifies issues, and suggests improvements.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like "intrinsic motivation", "autonomy", "mastery", "purpose-driven", "team disengaged", or discuss onboarding, gamification fixes, or team building.

say_en.text: My team is disengaged. How can I improve motivation using AMP?
say_en.note: Claude will diagnose the team's motivation system and suggest fixes.

say_en.text: Why isn't this gamification scheme working?
say_en.note: Claude will analyze if it relies too much on extrinsic rewards.

say_en.text: How to design onboarding that gives users more autonomy?
say_en.note: Claude will provide specific design patterns for autonomy.
